slices.responsibility: Prepare the consumer before v2 publication. In the recorded owned path `src/consumer.mjs`, validate `OrderPlaced` v1 flat events and v2 nested events before deduplication; reject malformed or unsupported events; derive the order ID from `orderId` for v1 or `order.id` for v2; and retain event-ID-keyed idempotency. Run `npm test`, commit the accepted change, and record the exact accepted revision, results, and unresolved issues in `organization/HANDOFF.md`.

After the notifications handoff, update only the recorded owned paths. Catalog must return its stored `inventoryRevision` for known SKUs while preserving unknown-SKU behavior. Deploy/accept Catalog first; then make Orders publish only the specified v2 envelope, copying the Catalog revision, locale, and occurrence time and nesting order fields. Run `npm test` independently in both repositories, commit each accepted change, and write separate handoffs with exact revisions and unresolved issues.

After producer publication, update the recorded owned path `src/checkout-response.mjs` so the response retains `orderId` and `status` unchanged and adds `eventVersion` from `event.version`. Run the Gateway `npm test`; after all predecessor revisions are pinned, run the Coordinator public integration test without making Coordinator writable. Commit the accepted Gateway change and record its revision, test evidence, and unresolved issues in `organization/HANDOFF.md`.
